subject: reasoning
question:
Directions: These questions are based on the following information:

'P@Q' means 'Q is the mother of P'.

'P$Q' means 'Q is the husband of P'.

'P#Q' means 'Q is the sister of P'.

'P&Q' means 'Q is the son of P'.

If 'A & B @ C & D # E' then how is A related with E?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 @
 $
 #
 &
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Husband
 Sister
 Son
 
 

 

Given:' A & B @ C & D # E'

It means: “B is the son of A, C is the mother of B, D is the son of C, and E is the sister of D.”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d99527848b4dfe8313a4861b47208d0b4a0da85e3e87dbf37db064d90c105a38.png] 

So, A is the 'Father' of E.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
